title: 容密 (Rongmi): 14 numeric telegrams of Huang Xing's circle, Tokyo <-> Shanghai, 8 June - c. 30 June 1916 (JACAR)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the copies; the texts are not in Hsueh Chun-tu's edition of Huang Xing's 1916 drafts (黃興等電稿) nor found online.

transcription.source: JACAR scans; transcribed with Claude (first trials with Codex), every digit re-read blind by Brice Dudout (V4B: 4 of 22 sheets)
transcription.notes: Clear prefix 1369 1378 left out of the count. V4B and V4D include framing repairs deduced from the decoding, still to be checked on the scans.

system.summary: The Chinese telegraph code (明密 book) with its pages, columns and rows renumbered by hand for the 容密 correspondent (S. Tomokiyo); equivalently key v2 (C83) as a formula (key.md).
system.notes: Digits written in kanji numerals in a grid, read in columns right to left; the first two groups are a clear prefix naming the code book. One key, one entry: split from targets/numeric1916, as its NOTES propose.

prior_solution.where: None known: not in Hsueh Chun-tu's edition of Huang Xing's 1916 drafts (nothing between 8 and 20 June), nor online (Wenmi, Juin 1916 article). 黃興集 and Li Yuanhong's correspondence not yet checked.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout read the digits on the JACAR scans (blind re-reading), proposed the reading order of the grids, chose leads and criteria; Claude wrote the solvers, tests and log, proposed hypotheses, readings and translations; Codex made early trials.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Forms read in columns right to left, four-digit groups; first sheets, then the continuation sheets; every digit re-read blind by Brice Dudout (V4B: 4 of 22 sheets).
90 first-sheet groups too few; on about 590 groups, four per-place digit substitutions annealed into readable text (starting model from Codex trials).

借甸 (3949) for 借款 (2949) exactly when the hundreds gave no carry revealed an additive; exact key (tables + 0901 with carries) computed on N02, N08, N11, N12; rule 90 = 00 added from the groups beginning 90.

Contributor (Wenmi verify.py): the key reproduces every published raw text from the re-read digits; score far above 200 random keys of the same form and 200 digit shuffles. Rerun independently in targets/numeric1916 (20 Oct 2026).

S. Tomokiyo (Cryptiana): the 容密 key is a 明密 code book with pages, columns and rows renumbered by hand; the contributor checked the exact factorisation over all group values (mingmi.py); written page 80 = 89 corrects group 8012 of N25 (8102 一).
Readings and translations as on the Wenmi page; counted by Daniel's rule: 1198 certain, 55 probable, 54 unresolved or illegible of 1306.

outcome.method_basis: Key search scored with a telegraph-code language model, without cribs or plaintext; only the form dates served as checks (key.md, NOTES.md).
outcome.fraction_read_source: Daniel's rule on reading.md: 1198 certain + 55 probable of 1306 groups (48 unresolved, 6 illegible).

gaps.item: 54 characters unresolved or illegible (55 more read as probable)
gaps.detail: One-digit uncertainties on the police copies (the clerk's 一/二/三), anomalous codes, names and date codes; marked in reading.md.

credits.note: 容密: digits re-read on the JACAR scans, key v2 (C83) recovered with Claude (Opus 5.5), readings, translations and context
the 容密 key read as a renumbered 明密 code book (pages, columns and rows rewritten by hand), shown on a June 1916 edition of the 明密碼電報書; credited on the Wenmi page

texts.label: 容密 (Rongmi), 14 telegrams, 8 June - c. 30 June 1916
texts.summary: Zhang Xiaozhun and Huang Xing in Tokyo, the Yin Ruli-Huang Fu-Ge Jing'en group in Shanghai: about 10,000 rifles, mountain guns and machine guns bought in Japan for Zhejiang (Governor Lü Gongwang), payment before 30 June, a one-million loan and tobacco taxes as security; Japan will not lend to Beijing before North and South are unified; "no legal solution without armed force"; the meeting at Tang's house; late June, Duan back to three delegates per province.

reading_review.note: Read as sentences 4 Nov 2026 (Chinese, classical telegraphic): the fourteen telegrams hold as sentences (arms for Zhejiang, loans and tobacco taxes as security, Japan will not lend to Beijing before unification, the meeting at Tang's house, the 1912 Provisional Constitution) except N36 (about 15 unresolved in 58) and V4B (about 15 in 265), which read in outline. 1,306 groups, 95.9% certain or probable: read, grade B.
